closures.reason: An old reader keeps its original directory for both load and SQLite reopen; the plan does not replace that directory/index/manifest. New imports use the new directory only after all its files pass cm.load(target,refresh=False). No shared path is switched between an in-flight load and query.
Exclusive xb creation, flush, fsync and readback occur before any destination write. A second acquisition fails rather than replacing the claim; an existing epoch also refuses restart.

limitations.detail: Per-file atomic writes are not a multi-file or crash-atomic transaction. A failure after os.replace but before readback may leave the verified new module active while switched is still false; the retained claim prevents automatic replay. Inspect actual module/root hashes before manual recovery. This does not recreate mixed-generation roots or claim installation success.
Exclusive reservation covers attempts using this package; optimistic module CAS is not a global lock against arbitrary independent deployers. No simultaneous writer is introduced by this plan.
No real race, process reload, installation or science executed. Resident availability and a fresh-process load/retrieval must be confirmed after a separately authorized install.
